prompt_md: Ann beats Bo by 10 m in a 100 m race. In a rematch at the same speeds, how many metres behind the start line must Ann begin so that they finish exactly together?
prompt_short: Ann beats Bo by 10 m over 100 m. Handicap for a dead heat?
hint_md: While Bo runs 100 m, how far does Ann run?
explain_intuition_md: Starting 10 m back would tie them at the 90 m point of Bo's old race, but Ann is faster, so she'd still win the last stretch. She needs a little more than 10 m of handicap.
explain_math_md: Speed ratio $\frac{100}{90}$. While Bo runs $100$, Ann runs $\frac{1000}{9} \approx 111.1$, so the handicap is $\frac{100}{9} \approx 11.11$ m.
